topic: Paying a surprise hospital bill instantly vs demanding an itemized bill first (Chad vs Yvette)

scenes.narration: Hospital bills are often padded with errors, and almost no patient ever checks. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom holding a hospital bill unrolling to the floor, comic burst banner reads CHECK THE BILL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Chad and Yvette each get nine thousand dollar emergency room bills.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man chad and woman yvette each holding a bill stamped 9000 DOLLARS DUE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both bills are one vague summary line with no codes listed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a close up of a bill with a single blurry line labeled SERVICES RENDERED and a huge total, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Chad panics and pays the full amount with a credit card.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, panicked man chad swiping a credit card at a hospital counter, a receipt stamped PAID IN FULL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Yvette requests a fully itemized bill listing every billing code.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman yvette at a hospital billing window handing over a form labeled ITEMIZED BILL REQUEST, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The itemized bill shows one procedure charged twice and duplicate supplies.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman yvette circling repeated lines on a long itemized bill with a red pen, a magnifier over a line labeled CHARGED TWICE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: An out of network doctor billed her at an in network hospital.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a hospital building labeled IN NETWORK with a doctor beside it labeled OUT OF NETWORK, a confused arrow between them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The No Surprises Act bans that charge, so she disputes it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an open law book titled NO SURPRISES ACT on a courtroom bench, woman yvette mailing an envelope stamped DISPUTE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Yvette's nine thousand dollar bill drops to eleven hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman yvette smiling as a giant number 9000 shrinks into 1100 on a bill, comic banner reads BILL CORRECTED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Chad requests a refund, but paid bills are far harder to reverse.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man chad on the phone at a kitchen table beside a paper stamped REFUND REQUEST PENDING, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He pays eight thousand dollars for charges he never actually owed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, sad man chad holding an empty wallet beside a receipt labeled OVERPAID 8000 DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Always request the itemized bill and dispute errors before you pay anything. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads ITEMIZE BEFORE YOU PAY, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
